name: mpdf/font-sunext-family
description: The Sun-Ext family of fonts for mPDF. Supported scripts include: Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, Armenian, Hebrew, Arabic, Syriac, Thaana, Devanagari, Bengali, Gurmukhi, Gujarati, Oriya, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Thai, Leo, Tibetan, Myanmar, Georgian, Hangul, Ethiopic, Cherokee, Canadian Aboriginal, Ogham, Runic, Khmer, Mongolian, Hiragana, Katakana, Bopomofo, Han, Yi, Buhid, Limbu, Braille, and Coptic.
